# Comprehensive Guide to Bed Bug Treatment in India

Bed bugs have become a prevalent issue in many Indian homes. This comprehensive guide aims to equip homeowners with everything they need and provide peace of mind.

## Effective Bed Bug Treatment Methods

Wash bedding and clothes at temperatures above 50°C, as bed bugs cannot survive such heat. Professionals use government-approved insecticides for highly effective eradication.

Professional treatment costs ₹3,000–₹10,000 per room in urban areas.

India's climate makes households particularly vulnerable. Kerala's humidity means moisture control is essential for bed bug control.

## Expert Insights

Dr. Arun Kumar, an entomologist at the Indian Institute of Pest Management, emphasizes, “Local environmental factors significantly influence bed bug behavior.”
